nights.title: ARLO PARKS - DESIRE TOUR | Gallery Seat
nights.name: Arlo Parks
nights.extract: Anaïs Oluwatoyin Estelle Marinho, known professionally as Arlo Parks, is an English singer and songwriter. Her debut studio album, Collapsed in Sunbeams, was released in 2021 to critical acclaim and peaked at number three on the UK Albums Chart. It won the 2021 Mercury Prize for Best Album and earned her nominations for Album of the Year, Best New Artist and Best British Female Solo Artist at the 2021 Brit Awards.

nights.title: Undeath
nights.name: Undeath
nights.extract: Undeath is an American death metal band from Rochester, New York founded in 2018.

nights.title: DON TOLIVER: NITROUS - OCTANE WORLD TOUR LEG 2
nights.name: Don Toliver
nights.extract: Caleb Zackery "Don" Toliver is an American rapper, singer and songwriter. His debut mixtape, Donny Womack (2018), was released one day prior to fellow Houston rapper Travis Scott's album Astroworld, on which Toliver made a guest appearance. In the following week, he signed with Scott's record label, Cactus Jack Records, in a joint venture with Atlantic Records.

nights.title: Lane 8 - Europe Tour
nights.name: Lane 8
nights.extract: Daniel Goldstein, better known by his stage name Lane 8, is an American musician, DJ, and electronic music producer. Currently residing in Denver, Colorado, he is signed to English deep house label Anjunadeep. Pete Tong named Lane 8 a "Future Star" and Dancing Astronaut included him in their '25 Artists to Watch in 2015'. His debut studio album Rise, was released on July 17, 2015. More recently, he has been releasing music through his own label This Never Happened.

nights.title: UCHE YARA - BODYSCANNER Tour 2026
nights.name: Uche Yara
nights.extract: Uchenna Yara Katzmayr, known professionally as Uche Yara, is an Austrian singer, songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, and record producer living in Berlin.

nights.title: Westside Cowboy
nights.name: Westside Cowboy
nights.extract: Westside Cowboy are an English rock band formed in Manchester in 2023. The band members are Jimmy Bradbury, Reuben Haycocks, Aoife Anson O'Connell and Paddy Murphy.

nights.title: Montell Fish - The Nest Tour
nights.name: Montell Fish
nights.extract: Montell James Frazier, also known as Montell Fish, is an American singer-songwriter. Formerly making music under the CCM genre, he switched to alternative R&B and neo soul. He has since signed to Virgin Music Group for distribution and released two albums under the deal: Jamie in 2022 and Charlotte in 2024.

nights.title: Isaiah Falls - LVRS PARADISE SIDE B TOUR
nights.name: Isaiah Falls
nights.extract: Isaiah Falls is an American singer from Orlando, Florida. He is best known for his 2024 single "Florida Baby". In September 2024, He was named Billboard's R&B/Hip-Hop Rookie of the Month.

nights.title: Nick Hakim - I Can See Live: In Concert
nights.name: Nick Hakim
nights.extract: Nicolas Hakim is an American musician based in Queens, New York, United States. His first EP, Where Will We Go Part 1 & 2, was self-released in 2014. He released three albums with ATO: Green Twins (2017), Will This Make Me Good (2020), and Cometa (2022).

nights.title: SON MIEUX - 24 Hours - EU Album Tour
nights.name: Son Mieux
nights.extract: Son Mieux is a Dutch indie pop group from The Hague headed by Camiel Meiresonne.

nights.title: Overmono - Pure Devotion - World Tour
nights.name: Overmono
nights.extract: Overmono is a Welsh electronic music duo consisting of the brothers Tom and Ed Russell.

nights.title: Kelsey Lu - So Help Me God Tour
nights.name: Kelsey Lu
nights.extract: Kelsey Elizabeth McJunkins, known professionally as Kelsey Lu, is an American singer and cellist based in Los Angeles, California.

nights.title: Digitalism - OPTIMISM TOUR 2026
nights.name: Digitalism
nights.extract: Digitalism are a German electronic music duo formed in Hamburg by Jens Moelle and İsmail Tüfekçi in 2004. The duo are signed to French label Kitsuné, as well as Virgin Records and Astralwerks in other parts of the world.

nights.title: Tove Lo - ESTRUS
nights.name: Tove Lo
nights.extract: Ebba Tove Elsa Nilsson, known professionally as Tove Lo, is a Swedish singer-songwriter. She is known for her raw, grunge-influenced take on pop music. Referring to her autobiographical lyrics, Out called Lo "the saddest girl in Sweden", while Rolling Stone called her "Sweden's darkest pop export".

nights.title: The Kid LAROI - A Perfect World Tour
nights.name: The Kid Laroi
nights.extract: Charlton Kenneth Jeffrey Howard, known professionally as the Kid Laroi, is an Australian singer, rapper, and songwriter. He was signed with American rapper Lil Bibby's Grade A Productions, in a joint venture with Columbia Records, in 2019. He is best known for his 2021 single "Stay", which peaked atop the charts in numerous countries including his native Australia, as well as the Canadian Hot 100 and Billboard Hot 100.

nights.title: Jessie Ware - The Superbloom Tour 2026
nights.name: Jessie Ware
nights.extract: Jessica Lois Ware is a British singer and songwriter. She came to prominence following the release of her debut album, Devotion (2012), which peaked at number five on the UK Albums Chart and produced the single "Wildest Moments". Her second album, Tough Love (2014), reached number nine in the UK and produced the singles "Tough Love" and "Say You Love Me". Her third album, Glasshouse (2017), reached number seven in the UK.

nights.title: Saint Levant - AFANDI WORLD TOUR
nights.name: Saint Levant
nights.extract: Marwan Abdelhamid, known professionally as Saint Levant, is a Palestinian singer-songwriter and rapper. A multilingual artist, he became known for his 2022 song "Very Few Friends". As of August 2026, he has released two EPs and two studio albums, and has toured in the Middle East, Europe, the US, and Australia.
